title: Trump departs PH to attend APEC in China
summary: United States President Donald Trump on Wednesday afternoon left the Philippines to attend the Asia Pacific Economic Cooperation in Shenzhen, China.

blocks.text: United States President Donald Trump on Wednesday afternoon left the Philippines to attend the Asia Pacific Economic Cooperation in Shenzhen, China.
Trump departed the country after attending a series of meetings with state leaders.
The US president arrived in the Philippines on Tuesday late afternoon to attend the Quad leader's summit, where he announced that the bloc will conduct an exercise featuring maritime patrol aircraft.
He also participated in a special summit with members of the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN).

In the summit, Trump reaffirmed his country's commitment to its allies in Southeast Asia and its key alliance with the Philippines, adding that the two countries are closer now “because of our personal relationship.”
Before he left the Philippines, Trump went to Malacañang as part of his state visit.
President Ferdinand "Bongbong" Marcos Jr. held a bilateral meeting with Trump and hosted a state luncheon in honor of the US leader. — RSJ, GMA News
